snippet.title: Petal Runner – Release Date Trailer – Nintendo Switch 2
snippet.description:
Petal Runner is coming exclusively to Nintendo Switch 2 on March 8, 2027! Download the free demo today: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/petal-runner-switch-2/?utm_campaign=A1013-01&utm_id=A1013-01&utm_medium=soytnoa&utm_source=SW

Join Cali and their sidekick Kira as the two fulfill their lifelong dream of becoming Petal Runners, an elite crew of motorcycle couriers. Deliver and install the newest, most impressive generation of digital pets across a vibrant coastal city.

Petal Runner features hand-crafted pixel visuals by content creator and artist Brandon James Greer, satisfying motorcycle rides through lush, lovingly detailed pixel art streets, and a wholesome but gripping narrative about life, loss, and what we carry with us.

#IndieWorld #PetalRunner

Visit Nintendo.com for more info: https://ninten.do/6008Spp2s
